name: Metabolite Increased Target With Genetic Disease Evidence
plain_language_rule: Predict treatment when The candidate drug independently affects the same disease The pinned descendant closure is biolink:affects, biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates. All more-specific descendants are explicitly excluded, leaving only biolink:affects.; The candidate drug forms the molecular metabolite The pinned descendant closure is biolink:has_metabolite. At least one primary source must be infores:chembl.; Metabolite causally affects gene in the increased direction for activity, activity_or_abundance The pinned descendant closure is biolink:affects, biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates. All more-specific descendants are explicitly excluded, leaving only biolink:affects. At least one primary source must be infores:chembl, infores:gtopdb, infores:drugcentral.; The gene has independent genetic association evidence for the same disease The pinned descendant closure is biolink:gene_associated_with_condition. At least one primary source must be infores:geneticskp. Additionally, The candidate drug and its metabolite must be different canonical nodes.
hypothesis: A drug may act through a formed metabolite whose curated molecular pharmacology engages a disease-implicated target.

constraints.explanation: The candidate drug and its metabolite must be different canonical nodes.

mechanism.rationale: A drug may act through a formed metabolite whose curated molecular pharmacology engages a disease-implicated target. The graph pattern is a hypothesis, not proof of clinical efficacy.

execution.cypher_template: MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[direct:{{relationship_types:direct}}]->(disease:Disease) WHERE direct.predicate IN {{predicates:direct}} MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[metabolism:{{relationship_types:metabolism}}]->(metabolite:ChemicalEntity) WHERE metabolism.predicate IN {{predicates:metabolism}} AND any(source IN ["infores:chembl"] WHERE source IN coalesce(metabolism.primary_knowledge_sources,[])) MATCH (metabolite:ChemicalEntity)-[target:{{relationship_types:target}}]->(gene:GeneOrGeneProduct) WHERE target.predicate IN {{predicates:target}} AND target.qualified_predicate = "biolink:causes" AND target.object_direction_qualifier = "increased" AND target.object_aspect_qualifier IN ["activity","activity_or_abundance"] AND any(source IN ["infores:chembl","infores:gtopdb","infores:drugcentral"] WHERE source IN coalesce(target.primary_knowledge_sources,[])) MATCH (gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[genetic:{{relationship_types:genetic}}]->(disease:Disease) WHERE genetic.predicate IN {{predicates:genetic}} AND any(source IN ["infores:geneticskp"] WHERE source IN coalesce(genetic.primary_knowledge_sources,[])) AND (chemical<>metabolite) RETURN chemical.id AS subject_id,disease.id AS object_id,count(DISTINCT gene) AS support_count

trapi.limitations: Outside TRAPI: direct: discard exact predicates biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates; metabolism: enforce primary-source membership in infores:chembl; target: discard exact predicates biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates; target: enforce primary-source membership in infores:chembl, infores:gtopdb, infores:drugcentral; genetic: enforce primary-source membership in infores:geneticskp; The candidate drug and its metabolite must be different canonical nodes.

limitations: Unknown predictions are unlabeled, not known negatives.
Canonical graph identifiers are deduplicated; parallel evidence does not multiply gene support.
A listed metabolite need not reach an effective concentration or have suitable exposure. Genetic or causal disease evidence does not establish the corrective pharmacologic sign.
